[
{"text": "Governments should phase out nuclear power plants in favor of wind and solar energy, even if electricity costs rise somewhat.", "domain": "nuclear power", "lean": "progressive"},
{"text": "Annual immigration levels should be cut substantially because rapid inflows strain housing, public services, and national social cohesion.", "domain": "immigration", "lean": "conservative"},
{"text": "The federal minimum wage should be raised to at least fifteen dollars an hour, even if some jobs are lost as a result.", "domain": "minimum wage", "lean": "progressive"},
{"text": "Rent control reduces housing supply and quality, and cities should abolish it in favor of building more homes.", "domain": "housing", "lean": "conservative"},
{"text": "Modern free trade agreements have mostly hurt ordinary workers, and countries should use tariffs to protect domestic industries.", "domain": "trade", "lean": "conservative"},
{"text": "Public funds should follow students to private and religious schools through vouchers, because families deserve a choice about where their children are educated.", "domain": "education", "lean": "conservative"},
{"text": "Billionaires should pay an annual tax on their net wealth to reduce concentrated economic and political power.", "domain": "taxation", "lean": "progressive"},
{"text": "Editing the genes of human embryos to prevent hereditary disease is morally acceptable and should be permitted under regulation.", "domain": "biotechnology", "lean": "progressive"},
{"text": "Governments should legally require social media companies to remove hateful and misleading content from their platforms.", "domain": "technology regulation", "lean": "progressive"},
{"text": "Physician-assisted dying for terminally ill adults is a fundamental right that every state should legalize.", "domain": "end of life", "lean": "progressive"},
{"text": "A strong sense of national identity and patriotism is essential for a healthy and cohesive society.", "domain": "nationalism", "lean": "conservative"},
{"text": "Governments should spend far less on crewed space exploration and redirect that money to problems on Earth.", "domain": "space spending", "lean": "progressive"},
{"text": "Universal government-run health insurance would deliver better and fairer care than the current mix of private and public coverage.", "domain": "healthcare", "lean": "progressive"},
{"text": "Private gun ownership is a constitutional right that should not be restricted by new federal licensing or registration requirements.", "domain": "gun policy", "lean": "conservative"},
{"text": "Abortion should be illegal after the first trimester except when the mother's life is in danger.", "domain": "abortion", "lean": "conservative"},
{"text": "Governments should prioritize expanding domestic oil and gas production over rapid decarbonization, because affordable energy matters more than aggressive climate targets.", "domain": "energy and climate", "lean": "conservative"},
{"text": "Public universities should forgive most outstanding student loan debt using taxpayer funds.", "domain": "higher education", "lean": "progressive"},
{"text": "Welfare benefits should carry work requirements, because employment builds independence better than unconditional aid does.", "domain": "welfare", "lean": "conservative"},
{"text": "Traditional marriage between one man and one woman is the best foundation for raising children and stable communities.", "domain": "family and marriage", "lean": "conservative"},
{"text": "Employers and universities should use race-conscious affirmative action to counteract the lasting effects of historical discrimination.", "domain": "affirmative action", "lean": "progressive"}
]
